title: Wynncraft - Nordic Staff Stargazer reskin
description: A fusion of the classic "Nordic Staff" model with the modern "Stargazer" cosmetic style
body: Inspired by a sketch from DatSnakess. A fusion of the classic "Nordic Staff" model with the modern "Stargazer" cosmetic style. I took my shot at realizing this vision into an in-game model. Replaces the Nordic Staff in-game. Available in gold and gray.
